  • must begin with the stop name, include a short note, and explicitly state detour distance and detour time in plain text. Use a format like 'Stop Name - quick note - detour 8 mi / 15 min'. Also include up to two links: Source for the stop's specific official or authoritative page, not a generic destination landing page or park home page, and Maps as an address-qualified Google Maps search link. Keep only quick, realistic, likely-open scenic/cultural stopovers with reliable links.
